tier_should.rationale: Integrates theory and practical evidence on AMCs; credible though evaluation is complex. Demonstrates large health impact and actionable design lessons. Modest methodological novelty suggests best fit is top field/policy journal rather than top-five general.

tier_will.rationale: Timely, highly policy-relevant topic with broad readership appeal. Even without breakthrough methods, visibility and impact make top field outlets (AEJ Applied, JHE, JEP) or AEA P&P likely; author/status advantages further improve placement.
